themes.name: Affordable Housing and Renting
themes.rule: Proposals that create, preserve, convert, subsidize, or regulate housing and rental conditions, including student housing and residential energy upgrades.

themes.name: Schools and Youth Learning
themes.rule: Proposals focused on school facilities, teachers, class conditions, student meals, tutoring, arts instruction, or school-age student access to education and transit.

themes.name: Public Spaces and Culture
themes.rule: Proposals that add or improve parks, gardens, playgrounds, libraries, dog areas, public art, museums, festivals, or other shared recreational and cultural amenities.

themes.name: Public Transit and Safe Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus service or rider information, or make walking and cycling routes and street crossings safer.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand preventive, primary, specialist, mental-health, or in-home care services for residents.

themes.name: Municipal Service Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make city services, information, or resident interactions with government easier through hotlines, in-person help, online systems, public data, or connectivity.

themes.name: Community Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime, improve public safety conditions, or expand emergency-response capacity through policing, lighting, cameras, or response stations.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution or waste, increase clean energy, or monitor environmental conditions through recycling, composting, plastic limits, solar power, or air-quality data.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support employment, worker training, local hiring, independent work, small-business finance, or business licensing.
